questions.explanation: Total parts = 10. Each part = 40/10 = 4. Larger = 7 × 4 = 28.

A can do a work in 15 days and B in 30 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/15 + 1/30 = 45/450. Time = 450/45 = 10 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 14 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 14² = 616 cm².

questions.explanation: Difference = 3 parts = 24, so each part = 8. Smaller = 2 × 8 = 16.

questions.question: A boat travels 60 km downstream in 4 hours. If the speed of the stream is 1 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 60/4 = 15 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 15 − 1 = 14 km/h.

questions.explanation: Total distance = 180 + 120 = 300 m in 15 s = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

questions.explanation: 61 mod 7 = 5; Friday + 5 = Wednesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th to the right of the 11th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 11th letter = K; 11 + 5 = 16th letter = P.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (7, 343), (9, 727), (5, 125), (2, 8)

questions.question: In a row of 55 students, Ravi is 42nd from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 55 − 42 + 1 = 14.

questions.question: Find the next term: 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, ?

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 9, 15, 23, 33, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 12, so 33 + 12 = 45.

questions.question: If RAIN is coded as VEMR, how is TREE coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to TREE gives XVII.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 2:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 2:00 the angle is 2 × 30° = 60°.
The relation is squaring: 10² = 100, so 12² = 144.

questions.question: A person walks 8 km East and then 15 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(8² + 15²) = √289 = 17 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 11 + 2 × 3.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 11 × 2 − 3 = 22 − 3 = 19.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 8, 16, 32, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2: 32 × 2 = 64.

questions.question: Complete the series: B, E, H, K, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is N.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 2, 17, 14, 11
questions.explanation: 11, 2, 17 are prime numbers; 14 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 5th letter from the right is the 22nd from the left = V.

questions.question: If today is Saturday, what day will it be after 66 days?
questions.explanation: 66 mod 7 = 3; Saturday + 3 = Tuesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th to the right of the 5th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 5th letter = E; 5 + 5 = 10th letter = J.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (5, 125), (6, 216), (3, 28), (7, 343)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 3³ = 27, not 28.

questions.question: In a row of 32 students, Ravi is 6th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 32 − 6 + 1 = 27.

questions.question: Find the next term: 64, 81, 100, 121, 144, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 8²…12². Next is 13² = 169.

questions.question: Find the next term: 6, 9, 15, 24, 36, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 15, so 36 + 15 = 51.

questions.question: If DOG is coded as EPH, how is MOON coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 1. Applying the same to MOON gives NPPO.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 5:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 5:00 the angle is 5 × 30° = 150°.

questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.question: "Vidhan Sabha" refers to the:
